grace_period.definition: unattended sessions whose oldest live pointer is older than the grace period
grace_period.rounding: rounded up to the next five minutes

cross_host_records.note: a follower registration records no host field at all, so every registration reads no_host; the pointer it belongs to carries launcher_host, and every pointer read at this census recorded the census host
cross_host_records.quantity: live pointers and follower registrations whose recorded host differs from the census host, and those recording no host at all

attribution.note: the two session ids available for a review dispatch are both engine sessions of dispatched workers - the reviewing worker's own, from its run's stream, and the reviewed run's worker's own, from its committed row payload - so they differ by construction and comparing them attributes nothing; the launching session is recorded only on a run's live pointer, under the session key, and that pointer is removed when the run is promoted

cross_session_sweep_actions.quantity: resumes and review dispatches a follower's sweep performed on a run whose session differs from the sweeping follower's session
cross_session_sweep_actions.resume_session_ids_are: the resumed run's own engine session, resolved from the run's stream (34 of 37) or its live pointer (3 of 37), not the sweeping session

orphan_population.quantity: live pointers grouped by session, whether any follower registration for the session is live, and whether its coordinator is still writing
orphan_population.transcript_freshness_caveat: ages are measured against the census moment, captured before the scan; a transcript written to during the scan shows a small negative age, which reads as written while the census ran
orphan_population.transcript_freshness_method: resolved by the crew follow arm that names the session, falling back to the newest transcript naming the session at all; the fallback is an upper bound on activity, because another session quoting the name counts, so the method used is recorded per session under coordinator_transcript_resolved_by

population.notice_definition: a record carrying the host's 'Monitor expired after Nm with K events delivered' event and a <task-id>, counted once per task-id

rearm_gap.quantity: seconds between a host Monitor expiry notice for a crew follow monitor and the next crew follow Monitor call in the same transcript

control_run_among_cross_session_sweep_ac.record_that_remains: its run directory holds stream.jsonl (the reviewing worker's own engine session, d00bdddf-64ed-4391-9bd0-bf2d956accde), stderr.log and prompt.txt; the prompt names no session, and the committed row carries no launching session
control_run_among_cross_session_sweep_ac.record_that_would_have_shown_it: a run's live pointer, ~/.config/reckon/crew/live/<run-id>.json, carries the dispatching session under the session key; for a review dispatch that is the sweeping follower's session. The pointer is removed when the run is promoted and this run is not live, so the record no longer exists
